verdicts.why: Sousa shakes May's hand when brought aboard the Zephyr in 1955, and May later says she felt his need to run; he runs, and the team I.C.E.R.s him and fakes his death. There is no Quinjet chase.
Simmons is undercover in Hydra by S2#3, where Whitehall decides to promote her; her cover is blown and Bobbi rescues her in S2#5.
The S2#8 flashback shows Reinhardt dissecting the unaged woman and Zabo finding her remains and swearing vengeance; that Cal pieced her back together is told in S2#17.
In S2#1 Creel kills Hartley's team and steals the Obelisk from Coulson's mercenaries for Whitehall; Coulson kills Whitehall in S2#10.
In S2#18 List sends Bakshi and Hydra agents after the teleporter, and they capture Lincoln and Deathlok for his experiments; the torture and rescue are in S2#19.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#16
value.text: Mike Peterson spends months hunting Dr. List, the HYDRA scientist experimenting on powered people, for Coulson.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who hunts List for Coulson.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist Mike hunts for Coulson.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#18
split.text: Sunil Bakshi offers Mike to Dr. List for his experiments, and List's HYDRA agents capture him along with Lincoln Campbell.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A cyborg Bakshi offers List for experiments, then captured.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist whose agents capture Mike for his experiments.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#19
split.text: Dr. List experiments on Mike alongside Lincoln Campbell, removing his eye and leg, until Coulson's team rescues him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A prisoner List experiments on, until Coulson's team rescues him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The HYDRA scientist who experiments on Mike.

verdicts.why: S2#16 hunt is right, but the proposed S2#18 split holds S2#19 facts: Bakshi offers Mike to List and Mike is captured in S2#18, while List removes his eye and leg and the rescue come in S2#19. The split is now two stages.
By S2#16 Coulson has sent Peterson to hunt List for months; Coulson gives Maria Hill the location of Strucker's base in S2#19.
The LMD Davis exists only in the one-year-later coda of S7#13, on a mission with Yo-Yo and Piper.
Piper asks for Davis back as her reward, and the LMD is seen with her in the S7#13 coda; bare S7 is too early.
Davis goes with Simmons to look for Aida at the Russian sub base in S4#14, and flies Zephyr One out of the Playground in S4#15.
In S4#21 Simmons I.C.E.R.s Fitz and Aida and the team locks them in a Containment Chamber together; when Aida attacks him, Piper, Davis and Prince pull Fitz out.
Davis is absent from S5#1-11. He helps rescue Coulson and May from South Ridge in S4#5, and the Principia search is S5#13.
In S5#1 Mack and Yo-Yo are held by the Kree apart from Deke; in S5#2 Deke finds them after they killed two Kree guards, much to his horror.
In S5#10 Enoch offers to sacrifice himself to power the machine and Deke activates it; Deke turns up in the present in S5#11.
In S5#12 Hale has Deke's cell examined after Daisy breaks him out, suspects an LMD and matches his DNA; she shoots him in S5#17.
Deke reports Daisy's plan to Kasius and gets her captured in S5#3; Kasius is killed in S5#10.
In S5#3 Sinara and Kasius watch Daisy's capture on Deke's information; in S5#9 Deke pulls Sinara off the stairs with a grappling claw to protect Daisy.
Deke meets the team in S5#1 and Coulson questions him until he learns they traveled through time; the Inhuman rescue and time jump are S5#10.
In S5#7 Flint decides to stay on the Lighthouse, and Mack and Yo-Yo stay behind to help him.
In S5#2 Grill implants metrics in Coulson, Mack and Yo-Yo on condition that they work for him; the scroll theft and framing of Zev are S5#3.
Yo-Yo is shot by a Primitive and Radcliffe suggests the blowtorch in S3#22; she first appears in S3#11.
Yo-Yo first comes to S.H.I.E.L.D.'s base in S3#17, where she gives Simmons blood samples; Simmons is not in Bogota in S3#11.

In S3#17 May surrounds the Secret Warriors at gunpoint, Yo-Yo takes her gun and walks out under May's escort, so they are not friends there. Yo-Yo comes back to join Coulson's team in S3#20, where May takes her along to hunt for Lincoln.
Yo-Yo is already a registered S.H.I.E.L.D. asset in S4#1, so Coulson does not bring her in at S4#3; there Coulson, Mack and Fitz save her as the Watchdogs are about to execute her.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#10
value.text: Yo-Yo learns from her future self that saving Coulson could doom the Earth.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Friend whose rescue, Yo-Yo learns, could doom the Earth.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who learns that saving Coulson could doom the Earth.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
split.text: Coulson heeds Yo-Yo's warning and refuses the serum that could save him.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Friend whose rescue could doom Earth. Heeds Yo-Yo's warning.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Friend who warns Coulson that saving him could doom the Earth.

verdicts.why: Yo-Yo learns the warning in S5#10, but she only tells Coulson in S5#19 and he heeds it in S5#22 by refusing the Centipede serum, so that part splits off.
In S7#1 Enoch is on the Zephyr and stands beside Yo-Yo while the team interrogates the hunter Cain; in S7#9 the team fights Enoch himself in the loop.
Ward narrowly beats Koenig's lie detector test in S1#19 to keep his cover.
In S1#7 Hand briefs Coulson, May and Ward at the Hub and assigns Ward and Fitz to South Ossetia; the Fridge escort is S1#17.
In S1#14 Coulson greets Ward's former S.O. John Garrett as he boards the Bus; the juvenile detention flashbacks are S1#21.
Ward catches Fitz and Simmons and ejects them into the ocean in the Bus infirmary in S1#21.

value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#20
value.text: Maria Hill tells May that Ward is Hydra, and they become bitter enemies.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Bitter enemy once Ward is exposed as Hydra.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
split.text: May beats Ward in a brutal fight at Cybertek.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Bitter enemy who beats Ward in a brutal fight at Cybertek.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Bitter enemy, exposed as Hydra, whom May beats at Cybertek.

verdicts.why: Bare S1 is too early, but the enmity starts in S1#20, when Hill tells May that Ward is Hydra, not in S1#22. The Cybertek fight is S1#22, so it splits off.
In S2#9 Ward boards the Bus, having traced Raina, and leaves with her and Skye.
In S2#14 Agent 33 kisses Ward and he says he wants her, and they break Bakshi out together; he accidentally kills her in S2#22.
Hunter tails the escaped Ward to Boston and raids Goldbrix Tavern in S2#7; Ward tortures Bobbi in S2#21.
S2#7: Ward leaves Bakshi tied up for S.H.I.E.L.D.; S2#14: Ward and Agent 33 break him out of Talbot's base and brainwash him; S2#19: Bakshi dies saving Ward from Simmons.
In S2#22 Kebo reports that Hydra's leaders are dead and Ward smashes his head into glass; in S3#2 they recruit more agents and kidnap Werner von Strucker together.
In S3#8 Malick confronts Ward at Strucker's vault and agrees to help him against S.H.I.E.L.D. if Ward helps return Hive.
Hive murders Stephanie in front of Malick at the end of S3#16; Malick's capture and death at Daisy's hands are S3#17.
Giyera kidnaps Fitz and Simmons for Hydra in S3#9; Fitz kills him with the Cloaked Gun in S3#22.

split.text: Gordon stands by Jiaying even when she tricks their people into a war with S.H.I.E.L.D.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Gordon's leader at Afterlife, who guides him through Terrigenesis.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Jiaying's loyal right-hand man, whom she guided through Terrigenesis.

verdicts.why: The 1983 flashback in S2#11 shows Jiaying guiding Gordon, but it is not shown that he serves her as Afterlife's leader until S2#16. That role splits off, and the war ruse stays at S2#21.
